% Shared visual language for every generated figure in this report.
%
% Hand-written: this file is design, not data. The figures that \input it are
% generated by benchmarks/make_figures.py from report/benchmark_results.tsv and
% must not be edited by hand.
%
% Colour is assigned to an *entity*, once, here -- so an estimator keeps its hue
% across every figure and a reader who learns "ipw+cal is green" is never
% contradicted. The categorical hues are the validated slots of the reference
% palette; each per-figure subset passes the colour-vision-deficiency and
% normal-vision separation gates on all pairs, and every series also carries a
% distinct marker shape, so identity never rests on colour alone. The two
% reference rows -- the uncorrected estimate and the oracle weights -- are
% deliberately achromatic: they are not competitors in the comparison, they are
% the two ends of the scale it is read against.

\definecolor{vizBlue}{HTML}{2A78D6}     % ipw            -- the covariate model alone
\definecolor{vizOrange}{HTML}{EB6834}   % cal            -- prevalence calibration alone
\definecolor{vizAqua}{HTML}{1BAF7A}     % ipw+cal        -- the recommended estimator
\definecolor{vizYellow}{HTML}{EDA100}   % ipw+cal/s      -- calibrated within strata
\definecolor{vizGreen}{HTML}{008300}    % ipw+cal/v      -- calibrated by severity
\definecolor{vizInk}{HTML}{2B2B28}      % oracle, text
\definecolor{vizMuted}{HTML}{5A5A54}    % naive, reference rules

\pgfplotsset{
  % Chrome recedes: hairline axes on two sides only, a grid one shade off the
  % page, and no frame. Everything here is deliberately quieter than the marks.
  viz axis/.style={
    axis x line*=bottom,
    axis y line*=left,
    axis line style={draw=vizInk!45, line width=0.5pt},
    tick style={draw=vizInk!45, line width=0.5pt},
    tick align=outside,
    tick label style={font=\scriptsize, text=vizInk!75},
    label style={font=\scriptsize, text=vizInk!85},
    title style={font=\small, text=vizInk, yshift=4pt},
    ymajorgrids,
    grid style={draw=vizInk!12, line width=0.4pt},
    legend cell align=left,
    legend style={
      font=\scriptsize, draw=none, fill=none, text=vizInk!85,
      /tikz/every even column/.append style={column sep=5pt},
    },
    clip=false,
  },
  % Marks are thin and small; error bars thinner still, so the estimate reads
  % before its uncertainty does.
  viz mark/.style={line width=0.9pt, mark size=2.1pt},
  viz bars/.style={
    error bars/.cd, y dir=both, y explicit,
    error bar style={line width=0.55pt},
    error mark options={rotate=90, mark size=1.6pt, line width=0.55pt},
  },
  viz xbars/.style={
    error bars/.cd, x dir=both, x explicit,
    error bar style={line width=0.55pt},
    error mark options={mark size=1.6pt, line width=0.55pt},
  },
  % One entity, one hue, one marker shape.
  viz naive/.style={viz mark, color=vizMuted, mark=square,
                    mark options={draw=vizMuted, line width=0.7pt}},
  viz ipw/.style={viz mark, color=vizBlue, mark=triangle*,
                  mark options={fill=vizBlue, draw=white, line width=0.4pt}},
  viz cal/.style={viz mark, color=vizOrange, mark=diamond*,
                  mark options={fill=vizOrange, draw=white, line width=0.4pt}},
  viz ipwcal/.style={viz mark, color=vizAqua, mark=*,
                     mark options={fill=vizAqua, draw=white, line width=0.4pt}},
  viz strat/.style={viz mark, color=vizYellow, mark=pentagon*,
                    mark options={fill=vizYellow, draw=white, line width=0.4pt}},
  viz severity/.style={viz mark, color=vizGreen, mark=star,
                       mark options={draw=vizGreen, line width=0.7pt}},
  viz oracle/.style={viz mark, color=vizInk, mark=o,
                     mark options={draw=vizInk, line width=0.7pt}},
  % A rule for a quantity that does not vary along the swept axis.
  viz rule/.style={line width=0.7pt, densely dashed, mark=none},
}
